episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Assistant District Attorney Andy Barber is assigned as the lead prosecutor in the case of his son's murdered classmate.

episodes.title: Everything Is Cool
episodes.summary: When new evidence is discovered, Andy is taken off the case.

episodes.title: Poker Faces
episodes.summary: Andy admits a family secret to Laurie before it becomes public.

episodes.title: Damage Control
episodes.summary: Andy takes matters into his own hands. Laurie is wounded by a misleading act of kindness.

episodes.title: Visitors
episodes.summary: Andy visits his father, and learns some troubling information from Jacob's friends Derek and Sarah.

episodes.title: Wishful Thinking
episodes.summary: Andy and Klein explore two last-ditch efforts to prove Jacob's innocence.

episodes.title: Job
episodes.summary: As the trial begins, Jacob's fate hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: After
episodes.summary: The trial comes to an end, but with unexpected consequences.
